messages.content: Decide only whether two adjacent source responsibilities belong to one local beat job. Return JSON only.

LEFT:
The technician opens the access panel.

RIGHT:
The technician turns away and begins documenting an unrelated spill.

Choose one:
MERGE = RIGHT is an immediate reaction to LEFT, continues the same uninterrupted local action, or is the immediate mechanical completion of what LEFT just obtained/opened/started.
NEW_TASK = LEFT reaches a usable stopping point and RIGHT begins a distinct local action/objective. Starting a fresh item/test after LEFT completed one is NEW_TASK. Merely carrying or wearing something from LEFT while doing a different task is NEW_TASK.
Judge only the concrete local actions.
Return exactly {"relation":"MERGE|NEW_TASK"}.

message.reasoning:
We need to decide if RIGHT belongs to same job as LEFT (immediate reaction, continues action) or new distinct task. LEFT: "The technician opens the access panel." That is a local action of opening an access panel.

RIGHT: "The technician turns away and begins documenting an unrelated spill."

So after opening the panel, he turns away and documents a spill that is unrelated to the panel. So it's a different objective. He didn't continue with the same task; he started new one. So relation = NEW_TASK.
